items.heading: "I Read Your Path From
items.text: "I read your path from X to Y. Could I ask two questions about how you chose Y?".

items.heading: Pick Five People Who Do
items.text: Pick five people who do the work you are curious about: a senior, a teacher, an alumnus or someone you met at an event. Read what they have shared publicly, and write two questions only they can answer.

items.heading: Regular Short Updates Turn Advice
items.text: Regular short updates turn advice into a relationship and sometimes into referrals.
